simulation.seed_rule: For each batch and offset x, early seed=seedbase+10*x and late seed=seedbase+10*x+1; anchors within a batch share common base draws.
simulation.raw_arrays_note: Full raw arrays were computed in-memory during r73 but are not serialized here; this compact summary replaces an earlier malformed oversized serialization attempt at the same path. Reproduce from the stated exact conditional-SNML simulator, adaptive-anchor procedure, seeds and hashes before treating raw counts as independently audited.

continuum_transport.anchor_bound: At anchor a and offset x, pair failure p_a<=u:=min(U_early,U_late).
continuum_transport.path_kl: For target r, D(path_r||path_a)=(128-x) D_KL(Q_r||Q_a), because the joint path through the later neighboring candidate contains 128-x post-change Q observations.
continuum_transport.binary_data_processing: For the pair-failure indicator, kl(p_r||p_a)<=D(path_r||path_a). Since p_a<=u, if p_r>=u then kl(p_r||u)<=D(path_r||path_a).
continuum_transport.cover_rule: Anchor a covers target r whenever (128-x)D_KL(Q_r||Q_a)<=kl(0.09||u).
continuum_transport.coverage_result: Using 137 adaptive anchors, the cover had no remaining gap over the entire r interval for every integer x in 0..32 at double-precision root/merge tolerance 1e-12. Therefore, on the simultaneous Clopper-Pearson event, pair failure probability is <=0.09 over the full exact I=0.5 Gaussian KL level and every discrete offset, leaving 0.01 absolute slack to beta=0.10.

scope_and_caveats: Exact KL level D_KL(Q||P)=0.5 only; not a theorem for all D_KL>=0.5.
Discrete-time step changes only. A between-sample changepoint maps to one integer partition; within-sample mixture changes are outside scope.
Negative mu is covered by global sign symmetry of the Gaussian MLE/SNML statistic.
Monte Carlo uncertainty is simultaneously controlled as stated, but interval root/coverage arithmetic is ordinary floating point rather than machine-verified interval arithmetic.
No O, O-derived state, other worker state/config, downstream comparator/integrator/index/feed/audit state, legacy/pre-independence research, shared ledger or other-role receipt semantics were used.
